summary: Add generation-fenced finite execution containment and event-backed retirement

replay.detail: Finite generation records retain the confirmed payload-release boundary; replayed records are not execution grants.

schema.detail: ExecGeneration adds an optional payloadReleasedAtUnixMs receipt. Existing records without it remain readable; finite stdout and stderr are retained separately.

rules.detail: Finite launches verify their Linux lane slice and scope before releasing the payload gate. Exact-generation retirement waits for whole-scope empty evidence, not merely parent exit.

compatibility.detail: Darwin reports logical-only coverage and refuses required whole-tree resource enforcement. Unprovable escaped-descendant retirement retains custody.

downtime.detail: Existing seat launch paths retain their behavior; finite containment is selected explicitly.

manual.detail: No host policy, systemd unit or production workload is enabled automatically.

recovery.detail: Kernel pidfd or kqueue notifications support exact-generation completion without polling. Cancellation of an exited old leader cannot stop a replacement generation.
